description: Describe nocturia as waking 2-3 times per night to urinate
presentation: Patient is a 28 year old man who has urinary frequency despite treatment for a presumed UTI. Patient has nocturia, waking 2-3 times per night to urinate, and workup for polyuria was done. CMP and A1c were normal but urine sodium and urine osm were both low. What further workup should be done to work up diabetes insipidus or other etiologies?
